#Help:
# Crosshair Studio Help

Crosshair Studio is a visual crosshair engine that overlays custom crosshair images on top of your game screen.

## Quick Start

Double-click to run the program. A transparent crosshair window will appear on your desktop. The program comes with 12 built-in `+` shape crosshairs that you can switch through.

- **Always on top**: The crosshair window stays above all other windows by default
- **Mouse passthrough**: The crosshair won't block mouse events, so you can interact with windows beneath it

## Crosshair Directory

The `crosshairs/` folder in the program installation directory is where you place your crosshair images. Supported formats:

- Image formats: `png`, `jpg`, `jpeg`, `gif`, `svg`
- Link formats: `txt` (contains image URL), `url` (Internet shortcut)

Tip: Use transparent background `png` or `svg` images for best results.

## System Tray

Right-click the system tray icon to open the menu:

| Feature | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| Pin / Unpin | Toggle crosshair window always on top |
| Show / Hide | Show or hide the application window |
| Mouse Passthrough | Toggle mouse event blocking |
| Switch Crosshair | Cycle to the next crosshair |
| Switch to Default | Switch to the user-set default crosshair |
| Set as Default | Set current crosshair as default |
| Monitor | Open the Monitor configuration panel |
| Reload | Restart the application |
| Exit | Quit the application |

## Hotkeys

### Global Hotkeys (system-wide, customizable in Settings)

| Feature | Default Keys |
|---------|-------------|
| Switch Crosshair | `Ctrl + Alt + Q` |
| Switch to Default | `Ctrl + Alt + D` |
| Set as Default | `Ctrl + Alt + S` |
| Toggle Pinned | `Ctrl + Alt + P` |
| Toggle Mouse Passthrough | Disabled by default |
| Open Monitor | `Ctrl + Alt + C` |
| Reload App | `Ctrl + Alt + R` |
| Exit App | `Ctrl + Alt + E` |

### In-App Hotkeys

| Feature | Key |
|---------|-----|
| Switch Crosshair | `Q` |

## Monitor Panel

Press `Ctrl + Alt + C` to open the Monitor panel for detailed configuration:

### Crosshair Parameters
- **Width/Height**: Adjust crosshair display size (0-400px)
- **Lock Ratio**: Toggle proportional scaling
- **Canvas Size**: Crosshair window dimensions (0-400px)
- **Canvas Shape**: Rectangular or circular mask
- **Invert Filter**: Adaptive inversion based on desktop background

### Crosshair Schemes
- Save current parameters as reusable schemes
- Apply a scheme's parameters and crosshair image with one click

### Crosshair Palette
- Custom drawn crosshairs (color, opacity, line width, line length, gap)
- Export to CS2 crosshair code format
- Preset crosshairs for CS2 and Valorant

### Settings Panel
- **Theme**: Dark / Light / System
- **Language**: English / Chinese
- **Notification**: System notification toggle
- **Config file**: Edit config.json manually (restart required)

## External Configuration

The `config.json` file in the program root directory stores all crosshair parameters, behavior settings, and hotkey bindings. You can edit this file directly to batch-modify settings. A restart is required for changes to take effect.

## Uninstall

- Delete the program installation directory
- Delete the data folder at `AppData/Roaming/com.crosshair-studio.app/` (approx. 5KB)
